_about: Editorial study notes for key words in John, written for this app and shown labelled 'Study note'. Every Chinese phrase quoted in ‘…’ is checked by build_lexicon.py to occur in the CUV text of John; every English rendering cited as WEB is checked against the WEB text. 'pos' gives a reviewed part of speech for words whose dictionary tag is missing or wrong. Each note belongs to one book ("book") and is verified against that book's CUV and WEB text.

道.note: In John, 道 renders the Greek logos. In 1:1–14 it is ‘the Word’, a title for Christ; elsewhere it is the word or message Jesus speaks (WEB “word”).

verses.JHN.1.1: Here 道 is ‘the Word’ (WEB “the Word”): the eternal Word who was with God and was God — a title for Christ, not the everyday sense ‘way’ or ‘road’.
verses.JHN.1.2: ‘The Word’ (WEB “The same”), continuing 1:1: the Word who was with God in the beginning.
verses.JHN.1.14: ‘The Word became flesh’ (WEB “The Word became flesh”): the Word of 1:1 takes on human nature.

太初.note: ‘In the very beginning’ — a literary word for the beginning of all things; WEB “In the beginning”. It echoes the first words of Genesis.

生命.note: Life (Greek zōē): in John, the life that comes from God through Christ; WEB “life”. Closely tied to 永生 ‘eternal life’.

光.note: Light — John’s image for Christ and God’s revelation, set against 黑暗 ‘darkness’ (1:4–9; 8:12 ‘我是世界的光’).

信.note: In John, 信 is almost always the verb ‘to believe’ (Greek pisteuō), often in ‘信他’ ‘believe in him’ — not the noun ‘letter’ listed in dictionaries.

恩典.note: Grace — God’s undeserved favour (Greek charis); WEB “grace”. In John it appears only in 1:14–17.

真理.note: Truth (Greek alētheia). In John truth is personal: ‘我就是道路、真理、生命’ (14:6).

荣耀.note: Glory, or as a verb ‘to glorify’ (Greek doxa, doxazō). In John, Jesus’ glorification points to his death and resurrection (12:23).

荣光.note: Glory, radiance: ‘我们也见过他的荣光’ (1:14), WEB “We saw his glory”.

救恩.note: Salvation. In John it occurs only at 4:22, ‘救恩是从犹太人出来的’ (WEB “salvation is from the Jews”).

世界.note: The world (Greek kosmos): sometimes the created world (1:10), often humanity turned away from God (15:18–19).

世人.note: People of the world, humankind. In 3:16, ‘神爱世人’ — WEB “God so loved the world”.

爱.note: To love. In John, often the love between the Father, the Son and the disciples — ‘彼此相爱’ ‘love one another’ (13:34).

圣灵.note: The Holy Spirit. John also calls him 保惠师 ‘the Counselor’ and ‘真理的圣灵’ ‘the Spirit of truth’.

永生.note: Eternal life — in John a present gift as well as a future hope: ‘信子的人有永生’ (3:36).

常在.note: To remain, to abide (Greek menō) — the key word of John 15; WEB “remain”.

神迹.note: Sign, miracle. John calls Jesus’ miracles ‘signs’ (WEB “signs”) because they point to who he is (2:11; 20:30).

人子.note: ‘The Son of Man’ — the title Jesus uses for himself; WEB “the Son of Man”.

保惠师.note: The Counselor or Helper (Greek paraklētos), the Holy Spirit; WEB “Counselor” (14:16, 26).

实实在在.note: ‘Truly, truly’ — the CUV’s rendering of Jesus’ double ‘Amen, amen’; WEB “Most certainly”.

肉身.note: Flesh, a human body: ‘道成了肉身’ (1:14), WEB “The Word became flesh”.

见证.note: Testimony, witness; 作见证 ‘to testify’. Witness is a major theme of John (WEB “testify”, “testimony”).

作见证.note: To testify, to bear witness (WEB “testify”) — said of John the Baptist, of the Father, of Jesus’ works and of the Spirit.

重生.note: To be born again; WEB “born anew” (3:3). The Greek anōthen can also mean ‘from above’.

羔羊.note: Lamb: ‘神的羔羊’ ‘the Lamb of God’ (1:29), echoing the Passover lamb.

独生子.note: Only son. Of Jesus: the ‘one and only Son’ (Greek monogenēs; WEB “only born Son”).

父.note: Father; in John usually ‘the Father’ — God, as Jesus speaks of him (WEB “the Father”).

罪.note: Sin; in some phrases ‘guilt’ or ‘crime’ (e.g. 定罪 ‘to condemn’).

神.note: God. In this edition (神版) 神 is preceded by a respectful blank space, as in printed CUV Bibles.

弥赛亚.note: Messiah (Hebrew ‘anointed one’); 1:41 explains it as 基督.

拉比.note: Rabbi, ‘teacher’; 1:38 explains it: ‘拉比翻出来就是夫子’.

哪哒.note: Nard (spikenard), a costly perfumed ointment — a transliteration of Greek nardos; WEB “nard” (12:3). Not listed in CC-CEDICT.

道@1JN.note: In 1 John, 道 renders the Greek logos: ‘the word’ or message of God (WEB “word”), and in 1:1 ‘the Word of life’. Not the everyday sense ‘road’ or ‘way’.

verses.1JN.1.1: ‘生命之道’ is ‘the Word of life’ (WEB “the Word of life”): the message about — and the person of — the eternal life that was revealed.
verses.1JN.3.9: Here the CUV has 道 ‘word’ where the WEB has “his seed”; the Greek word means seed, and the CUV takes it as God’s word remaining in the believer.

相交.note: To have fellowship, to share life together (WEB “fellowship”). The dictionary’s first sense, ‘to intersect’, is for lines and roads; in 1 John it is the shared life of believers with God and with one another.

挽回祭.note: ‘Atoning sacrifice’ (WEB “atoning sacrifice”): a sacrifice that turns away God’s anger at sin. Literally 祭 a sacrifice that 挽回 wins back. Older English Bibles say “propitiation”.

敌基督.note: ‘Antichrist’ (WEB “Antichrist”, “antichrists”): one who opposes Christ, denying the Father and the Son (2:22). In the CUV it is usually followed by 的 or 者 ‘the one who…’.

中保.note: Here ‘one who speaks for us’ before the Father (WEB “Counselor”); the Greek is paraklētos, an advocate. The dictionary gloss ‘middleman and guarantor’ is the general modern sense.

坦然无惧.note: ‘With confidence and without fear’ (WEB “boldness”): 坦然 ‘calm, at ease’ + 无惧 ‘without fear’.

太太@2JN.note: Here ‘lady’ (WEB “the chosen lady”, “dear lady”): a respectful way of addressing the letter’s reader — a Christian woman, or, as many readers take it, a church and its members (‘her children’). Not the modern ‘Mrs.’ or ‘wife’.

长老@2JN.note: ‘The elder’ (WEB “The elder”): the writer names himself by his role as a senior church leader; traditionally the apostle John.

长老@3JN.note: ‘The elder’ (WEB “The elder”): the writer names himself by his role as a senior church leader; traditionally the apostle John.

客旅.note: ‘Strangers, travellers’ (WEB “strangers”): believers travelling from church to church to preach, who depended on hospitality. 客 guest + 旅 travel.

提说.note: ‘To bring up, call attention to’ (WEB “I will call attention to his deeds”).

一无所取.note: ‘Taking nothing at all’ (WEB “taking nothing from the Gentiles”): 一无 not a single thing + 所取 that is taken.

该犹.note: Gaius — a personal name, the man this letter is written to; WEB “Gaius” (1:1). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

丢特腓.note: Diotrephes — a church leader who ‘loves to be first’; WEB “Diotrephes” (1:9). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

低米丢.note: Demetrius — a believer the elder commends; WEB “Demetrius” (1:12). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

亚勒腓.note: Alphaeus — father of Levi and of James; WEB “Alphaeus” (2:14). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

半尼其.note: Boanerges — the name Jesus gave James and John, explained as ‘sons of thunder’ (雷子); WEB “Boanerges” (3:17). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

巴多罗买.note: Bartholomew — one of the twelve apostles; WEB “Bartholomew” (3:18). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

达太.note: Thaddaeus — one of the twelve apostles; WEB “Thaddaeus” (3:18). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

格拉森.note: Gerasenes — the people of a region east of the Sea of Galilee; the CUV follows manuscripts reading ‘Gerasenes’ where the WEB has; WEB “Gadarenes” (5:1). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

睚鲁.note: Jairus — a ruler of the synagogue whose daughter Jesus raised; WEB “Jairus” (5:22). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

约西.note: Joses — a brother of Jesus; WEB “Joses” (6:3). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

低加坡里.note: Decapolis — the ‘Ten Cities’ region east of the Jordan; WEB “Decapolis” (5:20). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

叙利腓尼基.note: Syrophoenician — from Phoenicia in the province of Syria; WEB “Syrophoenician” (7:26). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

革尼撒勒.note: Gennesaret — a plain and town on the west shore of the Sea of Galilee; WEB “Gennesaret” (6:53). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

大玛努他.note: Dalmanutha — a place by the Sea of Galilee; WEB “Dalmanutha” (8:10). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

底买.note: Timaeus — father of the blind man Bartimaeus; WEB “Timaeus” (10:46). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

巴底买.note: Bartimaeus — the blind beggar of Jericho; the name means ‘son of Timaeus’; WEB “Bartimaeus” (10:46). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

伯法其.note: Bethphage — a village near the Mount of Olives (WEB spelling; WEB “Bethsphage” (11:1). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

客西马尼.note: Gethsemane — the garden where Jesus prayed before his arrest; WEB “Gethsemane” (14:32). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

古利奈.note: Cyrene — a city in North Africa; Simon of Cyrene carried the cross; WEB “Cyrene” (15:21). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

鲁孚.note: Rufus — a son of Simon of Cyrene; WEB “Rufus” (15:21). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

撒罗米.note: Salome — one of the women who watched at the cross; WEB “Salome” (15:40). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

亚利马太.note: Arimathaea — home town of Joseph, who buried Jesus; WEB “Arimathaea” (15:43). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

以土买.note: Idumaea — the region south of Judea (Edom); WEB “Idumaea” (3:8). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

亚比亚他.note: Abiathar — a high priest in King David’s time; WEB “Abiathar” (2:26). A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

希罗底.note: Herodias — wife of Herod Antipas, formerly his brother Philip’s wife — not the place Herodium that the dictionary lists; WEB “Herodias” (6:17).

大利大.note: Talitha — Aramaic, ‘girl’; WEB “Talitha cumi” (5:41). The Gospel itself gives the meaning (翻出来就是…).

古米.note: cumi — Aramaic, ‘get up’; WEB “Talitha cumi” (5:41). The Gospel itself gives the meaning (翻出来就是…).

以法大.note: Ephphatha — Aramaic, ‘be opened’; WEB “Ephphatha” (7:34). The Gospel itself gives the meaning (翻出来就是…).

以罗伊.note: Eloi — Aramaic, ‘my God’; WEB “Eloi, Eloi” (15:34). The Gospel itself gives the meaning (翻出来就是…).

拉马撒巴各大尼.note: lama sabachthani — Aramaic, ‘why have you forsaken me?’; WEB “lama sabachthani” (15:34). The Gospel itself gives the meaning (翻出来就是…).

各耳板.note: Corban — a Hebrew word for an offering dedicated to God; WEB “Corban” (7:11). Mark explains it: 各耳板就是供献的意思. A transliteration, not listed in CC-CEDICT.

阿爸.note: ‘Abba’, the Aramaic word for ‘father’, used by Jesus in prayer; WEB “Abba, Father” (14:36). The dictionary’s ‘(dialect) father’ is the modern colloquial use.

宣传.note: Here ‘to proclaim, preach’ (WEB “preaching the Good News”, 1:14). In modern Chinese 宣传 also means ‘publicity, propaganda’ — not the sense in the CUV.

异能.note: ‘Mighty works, miracles’ (WEB “mighty works”, 6:2). The dictionary sense ‘different function’ is modern and technical.

方言.note: Here ‘languages, tongues’ (WEB “new languages”, 16:17). In modern Chinese 方言 usually means a regional dialect.

选民.note: ‘The chosen ones, the elect’ — those God has chosen (WEB “chosen ones”, 13:20). The modern meaning ‘voters’ is not the sense here.

圣人.note: ‘A holy man’ (WEB “holy man”, 6:20), said of John the Baptist. In Chinese tradition 圣人 also means a sage such as Confucius.

巡抚.note: Here the Roman governor, Pilate. The CUV borrows the title of a Ming–Qing provincial governor.

抽风.note: ‘To go into convulsions, have a fit’, as the boy does in 9:20 (WEB “convulsed”). Not the modern sense ‘to ventilate’.

verses.MRK.1.26: In 抽了一阵风 the phrase means ‘threw him into a convulsion’ (WEB “convulsing him”), not ‘a gust of wind’.
verses.MRK.9.26: In 抽了一阵风 the phrase means ‘convulsed him greatly’, not ‘a gust of wind’.

只@MRK.note: Read zhī after a number (两只手 ‘two hands’, 一只船 ‘a boat’): the measure word for hands, feet, eyes, boats and animals. Read zhǐ it means ‘only’.

擘.note: ‘To break (bread)’ (WEB “broke the loaves”, 6:41). Churches read it bāi, as in 擘饼 ‘breaking of bread’; dictionaries list it as bò.

百夫长.note: ‘Centurion’ (WEB “centurion”, 15:39): a Roman officer over about a hundred soldiers. 百 hundred + 夫 men + 长 head.
